article.title: 3D post-implantation co-culture of human embryo and endometrium
article.citation: Song J et al. Cell Stem Cell. 2026;33(1):58-72.e7. doi:10.1016/j.stem.2025.12.002.
article.source_review_depth: Publisher/PubMed abstract, publisher supplemental workbook cell audit, supplemental-figure caption screen, and relevant full-article passages from a third-party mirror; mirror provenance remains unverified

reported_scope.model_question: Model reciprocal human embryo-endometrial communication during implantation and early post-implantation development.
abstract_claims: The abstract reports yolk-sac formation, primordial germ-cell specification and trophoblast maturation through the described day-14 endpoint.
The abstract reports day-9 extravillous trophoblast emergence associated with the endometrial niche.
The abstract reports that disruption of maternal signals, including hCG signaling blockade, impairs embryonic progression.
reported_scope.survival_comparison_reported_in_article: At d.p.f. 14, 15/20 (75%) co-cultured embryos and 6/16 (37.5%) sole-embryo controls met the authors' morphology-based survival definition.
reported_scope.survival_definition: Continued diameter expansion from d.p.f. 5 to 14 and no visible apoptosis signs by daily light microscopy; this is an author-defined morphology endpoint, not a general health measure.
survival_population_qualifications: The article describes morphology-based inclusion/exclusion but gives no total number screened or excluded.
The article says cultures ended at d.p.f. 14 or primitive-streak formation but does not map earlier termination to the reported survival numerator.

data_routes.workbook_structure: Three visible sheets, one populated. Sheet1 has four populated blocks: a 35-cell cluster-proportion matrix (A1:F8), a 35-cell cluster-count matrix (A11:F18), a 28-cell stage count/printed-percent summary (D22:G28), and an 8-cell consolidated embryo Epi/TE summary (B32:E32 and B35:E35). No row-per-embryo records or embryo/site identifiers.
data_routes.workbook_structure_correction: The Cycle 195 screen described the populated sheet as a single 35-row cluster-by-five-label table. The Cycle 203 cell-level review identified three additional populated count/summary blocks; the earlier receipt remains unchanged as a historical record.

pmc_fulltext_route_screen.interpretation: The queried NCBI PMC and Europe PMC routes did not provide a full-text record for this PMID. This route-specific result does not prove that no other public or controlled copy exists.

publisher_fulltext_route_probe.interpretation: The publisher listing describes the article as open access, but the tested publisher routes returned 403 from this environment. This is a route-specific access result, not evidence that the article is not publicly accessible elsewhere.

data_routes.geo_candidate_qualification: The GEO record has no PubMed relation. The apparent Zhang X initial match resolves to different full names in NCBI metadata (Xinbao Zhang in GEO; Xinwen Zhang in the Song paper). The article's data-availability section names GSA-Human HRA006892 for single-cell RNA-seq, but no crosswalk links that accession to GSE263528. No exact full-name match was found; keep the GEO candidate unjoined pending direct provenance.

article_declared_data_accessions.code: no original code or algorithms reported

repository_access_conflicts.HRA006892: Article says publicly available as of publication; the current GSA-Human page labels the record controlled access (released 2026-07-31). Its public page exposes partial metadata: five repository individual/sample accessions and ten run-table rows representing five distinct run accessions across five samples/experiments. The page says detailed metadata download is limited to authorized users. These rows are not linked to the article's survival cohorts.
repository_access_conflicts.PXD067943: The official ProteomeXchange route says the accession is reserved by PRIDE for a deposited dataset not yet publicly released or announced; its public route returns HTTP 404. The direct PRIDE public project API also returns 404 while known-project controls succeed. This conflicts with the article's publication-time availability wording and does not establish data absence.

data_routes.route_scope_qualification: The queried repository routes do not establish that data are absent from other public or restricted routes.

observation_intake.reason_not_promoted: Two group-level survival percentages are preserved in a candidate summary intake with source-reported numerators and denominators. No individual embryo rows are promoted: embryo identities and fates are absent, the screened/excluded denominator is unreported, and primitive-streak early stopping is not mapped to the survival numerator. The source is a third-party article mirror pending human review; the exact PMID checks did not locate PMC full text, and publisher-byte equivalence remains unverified. The workbook also retains one printed stage-percentage conflict and an unexplained Epi/TE denominator split.

feasibility_boundary.supports: Candidate human early-interface evidence through d.p.f. 14, including a group-level morphology-defined survival comparison; screened-population and early-termination mappings remain unresolved.
